title: AI Fashion Model
tagline: Any dress, any pose — no photoshoot required.

meta.title: AI Fashion Model | Foxtroit AI
meta.description: Any dress, any pose — no photoshoot required.

blocks.title: The Problem
blocks.content: Product photoshoots are expensive to run for every SKU, and shoppers who can't picture the fit on themselves are more likely to abandon the purchase.

blocks.title: The Solution
blocks.content: Generative AI synthesizes a photorealistic image of the uploaded garment on the chosen model pose, standing in for a full studio shoot.

blocks.title: Outcome
blocks.content: Sellers cut photoshoot and model costs while giving customers a clearer preview before they buy.
